'''Lysennius Melchiro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] politician who was appointed governor of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] following the [[Great Galactic War]]. However, his inept leadership allowed the [[Balmorran resistance]] to gain too much of a foothold, prompting the [[Dark Council]] to send [[Darth Lachris]] to take charge. Disgusted by his weakness, Lachris [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Choke|Force choked]] the governor to death, and assumed control of Balmorra herself.

==Behind the scenes==
Governor Melchiro is only seen briefly while being Force-choked by Darth Lachris. The dark side option is to do nothing while Lachris kills him, while the light side option involves speaking up, thus saving his life. The article implies the dark side option to be canon.
